title: AI-assisted class insight (baseline)
body: Public OULAD + dialogue prototypes suggest reviewing justification depth relative to raw click volume — use as a risk indicator for discussion with learners, not as a sole basis for high-stakes decisions.

title: Heuristic dialogue pattern
body: Confusion heuristics align with shorter reflective turns in the education dialogue sample (labels are not validated ground truth).

title: Suggested teacher action
body: Add structured rationale scaffolds after decision points; reinforce safe-to-fail reflection prompts.
